verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing pages describe custom automations, including 'rules that move work forward' and automated reminders (jira-docs-4). They also describe automation that connects tools like Bitbucket and Slack to Jira workflows and keeps Jira up to date (jira-intdir-1, jira-docs-22), plus AI-driven auto-assignment (jira-docs-10). The evidence is only high-level marketing copy, and much of it frames automation through Rovo AI rather than a user-built rule engine. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a trigger/condition/action rule builder, a catalog of available triggers and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building rules.
